name: Quinn's Potion
summary: At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel prepares Quinn's Potion for an injured scout. Quinn Yorick needs it after a disastrous patrol in Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: Renferrel's Cure
sections.body:
Apothecary Renferrel brews a remedy for Deathstalker Quinn Yorick. Word reached the Royal Apothecary Society at the Sepulcher after Quinn was badly hurt near the Ivar Patch and could no longer move. Renferrel made the draught to help him recover.

Minor field casualties rarely draw Renferrel from his darker research for Lady Sylvanas. Still, he supplied the remedy so Quinn could regain enough strength to travel.

faq.q: What is Quinn's Potion used for?
faq.answer: Quinn's Potion helps Deathstalker Quinn Yorick recover from his injuries in northern Silverpine Forest. It restores enough strength for him to travel again.
Apothecary Renferrel, an alchemist of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in the Sepulcher's crypts, brewed the draught.

faq.q: Where does the potion need to be delivered?
aliases: where do i take the potion
faq.answer: Carry the potion north of the Sepulcher to Quinn Yorick, sheltering near the farmstead called the Ivar Patch.

faq.q: Why was Quinn Yorick in need of a potion?
faq.answer: Quinn was scouting northern Silverpine with a Deathstalker patrol. At the Ivar Patch, the ghoul Ivar the Foul attacked the scouts, leaving Quinn badly hurt and stranded.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know the Royal Apothecary Society rarely spends effort on simple field remedies unless they help preserve scouts guarding Silverpine's borders.
